name: Community Stewardship Grants (State NRM Program)

funder.name: Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development (Western Australia)

summary: Annual Western Australian Government grants for incorporated not-for-profit and community groups to protect and restore the local environment, from small projects to large strategic ones, with on-ground works such as revegetation, fencing and invasive species control.

amount.note: Small grants $1,000 to $50,000; large grants $50,001 to $450,000

status.quote: Start Date: 12 March 2026 End Date: 29 April 2026 Status: Closed

opens.quote: Start Date: 12 March 2026 End Date: 29 April 2026 Status: Closed

deadline.quote: Start Date: 12 March 2026 End Date: 29 April 2026 Status: Closed

pool.quote: In 2026, $7 million in funding is available to support community-driven natural resource management projects across the state.

applicant_types.quote: Land Conservation District Committees local government authorities primary and secondary schools.

geography.quote: Projects must be based within the state of Western Australia.

access.quote: To be eligible to apply, applicants must be an incorporated not-for-profit organisation with an ABN.

window.quote: Community Stewardship Grants are available annually to support community-based projects that serve to protect and restore the local environment.

amount.quote: Small grants valued between $1,000 and $50,000 up to 18 months duration. Large grants valued between $50,001 and $450,000
